name: fix-salvage
about: Issue #66: Destroy becomes Salvage (fix_salvage bot). In the character screen a bag item's hint reads Salvage, E opens a confirm naming the yield and No keeps it; Yes salvages a Rare ilvl 20 Long Sword into 3 Dust and a Common ilvl 1 into 1 Crystal, given to the town. salvage.yield 200 doubles the yields; salvage.enabled off is the vanilla Destroy (nothing given). In the town stash a bag item's Epic ilvl 30 Long Sword salvages into 12 Dust.
